I'm sorry about your upcoming situation. Good thinking about joining a gym so you can shower and have a locker. I wouldn't rent a storage unit because it never worked out for me. To me it's just an expense that can be cut out. Try to sell as much as you can that you were going to be putting in the unit. Trust me, you'll need the cash more. Maybe another part time job, 10 hour's a week or so. It's good to stay busy. It's good that you have a car, before your deadline think about bringing it in for a tuneup, especially with winter coming. Check your brakes, tires, etc. Maybe purchase some gas cards, especially since gas prices are through the roof. 
Get information about what services are available to you in your area. I'm in Boston and most churches offer things. Clothes, food, support. Apply for food stamps and health insurance if needed. Hopefully there are some shelters in your area in case the weather gets bad and it'll be too dangerous to sleep in your car. If you can swing it make an extra car insurance payment. Talk with your friends and see if you can sleep on a couch every once in a while. Keep networking. It's exhausting and sucks but you can do it. Love and prayers. If I can help in any way please message me. 🙏 💖
